main_training.scheduler: linear decay reset each task, zero warmup

selection_rule: earliest epoch with highest current-task dev candidate accuracy; no test-based selection
evaluation: all three fixed test tasks at stages 0,1,2,3; paired image and no-image conditions for language methods

extra_compute.EWC: 32 balanced train-example backward passes after tasks 1 and 2, lambda=5000
extra_compute.KD: previous-stage full-vocabulary teacher outputs on current training examples, temperature=2, lambda=0.5
extra_compute.SAPT: existing implementation, 1 generator epoch and 128 pseudo examples at first two boundaries

MedQwen_port.targets: same q_proj/v_proj as all language methods
capacity_controls: ordinary rank-13 LoRA, near matched total adapter parameters

RA_LDL_port.features: mean frozen Qwen merger tokens, 1536 dimensions; same images and visual resolution
RA_LDL_port.optional_backbone_adapter: omitted to preserve common frozen vision encoder
RA_LDL_port.incremental_update: cumulative Gram and class statistics, closed form ridge
RA_LDL_port.candidate_set: same four source-specific options for primary metric; all seen classes also recorded
RA_LDL_port.source: official code at pinned revision; feature-level port

interpretation_limits: one three-task sequence, 372 train images, synthetic diagnosis questions, no patient identifiers; algorithm ports rather than original-paper reproduction
implementation_freeze: record hashes of code and data before first execution; modifications require auditable new version and rerun affected comparisons
